import sys
x = int(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 1
def nxt():
    global x
    x ^= (x << 13) & 0xFFFFFFFF; x ^= x >> 17; x ^= (x << 5) & 0xFFFFFFFF; x &= 0xFFFFFFFF
    return x
ops = ['+', '-', '*']
n = 3 + nxt() % 4
expr = str(nxt() % 100)
for _ in range(n):
    expr += ' ' + ops[nxt() % 3] + ' ' + str(nxt() % 100)
print(expr + ' = ' + str(eval(expr)))
